extraction: DERIVED, not upstream: plain-text rendering of the paper PDF produced locally with poppler pdftotext -layout. The arXiv source for 1802.00465 contains only a wrapper .tex plus the compiled PDF, so no LaTeX tables exist for this paper.
note: Aniyan et al. 2018 (MNRAS 476, 1909), Resolving the Disc-Halo Degeneracy I: NGC 628. Tables 4, 5 and 6 carry the resolved sigma_z(R). The two-column PDF layout interleaves table cells with body text, so these tables were NOT machine-transcribed to TSV - transcribing them safely needs the journal machine-readable version or manual entry. See WARPS_AND_VERTICAL.md.
